about_the_game:
Fate & Inflation is a game that combines RPG roguelite elements with card building mechanics. Embark on a mysterious and unknown journey of fate, constantly strengthening yourself, and experience the thrilling charm of exponential combat power growth!

Content available for experience in the demo version

1/4 of the characters are available, and about 1/5 of the card skills, enemies, and items can be experienced

Unique combat style

This game's combat system employs a non-traditional turn-based approach, where enemies have a countdown timer. Each time you play a card, the enemy's countdown is reduced by 1. When the enemy's countdown reaches zero, it will launch an attack against you. During combat, you can select up to 5 cards to attack the enemy at a time. The total damage caused by each attack is determined by multiplying the sum of the points on the cards by the card type multiplier and then by the level. Combined with the skill effects attached to each card, making reasonable choices ensures that each attack is unique.

Exaggerated numerical inflation

After defeating enemies and achieving victory in battle, you will obtain their levels. As the game progresses, the numerical values of both the enemy and your own characters will rise to an extremely exaggerated level. So much so that you may encounter counting units that you have never encountered before
